ModMetaData.name: Important Clean (e71)
ModMetaData.author: e71
ModMetaData.description:
Cleaners clean the rooms where cleanliness matters before the rest of the home area.
Adds a "clean important rooms" job to the Cleaning work type, ahead of vanilla filth cleaning and snow or sand clearing. It covers every room type whose stats count cleanliness: kitchens, hospitals, laboratories, bedrooms, barracks, dining rooms, rec rooms and prison cells. Everything else is cleaned as usual once those are done.
Works for anyone who does Cleaning, including modded worker animals such as Housekeeper Assistance Cats.
Safe to add to or remove from an existing save. No Harmony needed.
